recovery.title: Creatine
recovery.desc: 5g daily with warm water or tea.

recovery.title: Salt & Water
recovery.desc: Warm water + sea salt pinch when dragging. Then a 15-min nasal-breathing walk.

tips: Long day. No set goes to failure: sets 1–2 stop 2 reps short, set 3 stops 1 rep short. After the last pair, run Bike Intervals instead of the easy bike.
Rest day. Sleep is the training session. When work stress spikes, protect it.
Lower day: warm up on the bike and keep the easy bike truly easy afterwards. Nose breathing, full sentences.
After lifting, run Bike Intervals instead of the easy bike. Three-week trial: if leg press stalls or sleep slips, go back to Sunday intervals only.
Rest day. Recomp runs on protein: 1.6–2.2 g per kg of bodyweight daily, spread over 3–4 meals.
Progression: when every set hits the top of the rep range at 1–2 RIR, add the smallest weight jump next week.
Rest day. Stress bloats the scale for days. Judge progress on weekly averages and strength trends, not one weigh-in.
